title: Police Fine Abroad
scenario: Someone claiming to be police demands immediate cash for a minor tourist violation.

answers.A: Ask for official identification and the written fine process.
answers.B: Hand over cash immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.C: Take a photo of the person ID and pay if it looks official.
answers.D: Contact your hotel, local authority, or embassy for help while staying calm.

explanation: Real enforcement has an identifiable process and receipt. Fear and immediate cash demands are reasons to slow down and seek an independent check.
proTip: Stay respectful, keep your documents, and ask for the official process.
